result:
I ran all 14 queries against the data files. Each produced a plausible answer. I didn't check any answer against the raw data by hand.

- **Z2:** My test run printed `31` before I added `round 1`, so the final form wasn't run.
- **Z3:** `162.48`.
- **Z6:** `4`.
- **Z10:** `7`.
- **Z12:** `252.7`.
- **Z13:** `475.47`.

Z4, Z8 and Z11 answer maps whose keys are keywords, which is how qlang reads JSON keys.

Z1: ["berlin" "madrid" "paris"]
Z2: and Z5 to Z14 follow below.

Z1: get /users | filter ~(allOf (get /active | eq true) ~(query /address/city | ne null)) | map ~(get /address/city | lower) | distinct | sort
Z2: get /users | filter ~(allOf (get /active | eq true) ~(get /age | ne null)) | map /age | avg | round 1
Z3: filter ~(get /status | lower | eq "paid") | map ~(query /items [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
Z4: filter ~(get /status | lower | ne "cancelled") | map ~(get /customer | lower) | groupBy | map ~(count)
Z5: filter ~(get /status | lower | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(get /customer | lower) | map ~(map ~(query /items [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum) | entries | sort ~(get [~(get /1 | desc) /0]) | take 3 | map ~(get /0 | toString)
Z6: filter ~(allOf (get /state | eq "open") ~(get /assignee | eq null) ~(get /labels | map ~(lower) | contains "bug")) | count
Z7: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | sort ~(get [~(get /comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~(get {:number /number :title /title})
Z8: groupBy ~(query /assignee/login "unassigned") | map ~(count)
Z9: get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | reduce {} ~(merge) | entries | filter ~(get /1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(get /0 | toString | lower) | sort | join ","
Z10: get /services | filter ~(get /enabled | eq true) | map ~(query /replicas 1 | coalesce 1) | sum
Z11: lines | map ~(split " ") | groupBy ~(get /3 | take 1 | append "xx") | map ~(count)
Z12: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /1 | eq "GET") | map ~(get /4 | replace "ms" "" | toNumber) | avg | round 1
Z13: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(get /2 | lower | eq "tools") | map ~(get {:q ~(get /3 | if (eq "") ~(0) ~(toNumber)) :p ~(get /4 | toNumber)} | mulOf /q /p) | sum | round 2
Z14: "alice@Example.com, bob@example.org; carol@EXAMPLE.COM, dave@mail.test, erin@Example.org, frank@mail.test" | scan #"@[^,; ]+" | map ~(drop 1 | lower) | distinct | sort
